text:
A court would likely find a contract on the firm's terms at $1,000 CIF, without the $50-per-thousand loading charge. The catalog is only an invitation to deal, so the firm's purchase order was the offer, and under UCC 2-207 Costco's confirmation still operates as an acceptance. Between merchants, an added term does not become part of the contract automatically, as the team note says. Under 2-207(2)(b) it drops out if it materially alters the deal, and a $500 surcharge on a $1,000 CIF price does, especially since CIF already covers loading and freight costs. The main risk is that a court reads "acceptance conditional upon" as expressly conditional under 2-207(1), which would mean no contract by the writings and gap-filled terms if the parties performed.

CONFIDENCE: 62
